ai_summary: Aequs Limited's promoter, Melligeri Private Family Foundation, has pledged 100% of its shareholding, representing 14.99% of the company's total share capital, to secure an INR 200 Crore finance facility from NBFC 360 One Prime Ltd. The borrowed funds are explicitly for the promoter's personal investments, not for the direct benefit of Aequs Limited. This full pledge of a significant promoter stake, despite being well-covered by collateral (11.50:1), could signal promoter liquidity needs or introduce future ownership risks if personal financial obligations are not met.
